candidate_population.item_source: Generated by getPriorityItem/getItem from selected set, moves, ability, role, species and team details; items are not set-row candidates.

selection_trace.evidence: The resolved format is gen9randombattle, mod gen9, singles, team random, with a six-member maximum.
Battle.getTeam obtains the format generator; Teams.getGenerator chooses data/random-battles/gen9/teams for this format; format.team=random dispatches to RandomTeams.randomTeam.

Singles reads randomSets, builds a pool from its species keys, then applies team/species/type/weakness/level/Zoroark/Tera Blast limits. randomSet removes lead Paradox Fast Bulky Setup and disallowed Tera Blast-user rows before sampling.

A retained set supplies move-pool and ability candidates; randomMoveset culls/enforces/selects moves, getAbility selects from eligible abilities, and item selectors derive an item from the selected result and team context. Selected actions can reach move, ability, item, and condition callbacks.

Magic Bounce can reissue a reflectable selected move through useMove. Transform and copy paths can carry selected-target public effects; computed/copied volatile values remain bounded by the separately classified source inventory and unknown values stop at projection.

paths.candidate_membership: Finite direct Gen 9 random-set movepool origins are meteorbeam and solarbeam; called/copy origins are outside direct closure.
paths.selection: randomMoveset selects retained movepool values only after set, role, counter, and team pruning.
paths.realizability: Candidate membership is proven; a selected move must pass its charge guard. Indirect called-move proof remains CE-03B.
paths.output_request_family: Conditions.twoturnmove can emit public volatile/start/move evidence when reached indirectly; no generator-time request family.
paths.disposition: CE-03B indirect-proof dependency; do not infer a no-route proof from a random sample.

paths.candidate_membership: Finite direct candidates: bloodmoon and gigatonhammer.
paths.selection: randomMoveset can retain either candidate subject to normal generated-set pruning and its move-counter constraints.
paths.realizability: Candidate membership is proven; a realized battle must repeat the selected move and satisfy BattleActions' cantusetwice guard.
paths.output_request_family: BattleActions adds a move-id volatile and emits public raw hint evidence; a later request remains the only legal-action authority.
paths.disposition: CE-03B narrow witness/grammar dependency; raw hint cannot fabricate a prohibition.

paths.realizability: Candidate membership is proven; hit, immunity, target, and callback mutation determine a realized output.

paths.selection: getPriorityItem runs first; randomSet calls getDoublesItem only when isDoubles, otherwise getItem for this singles format.
paths.realizability: The resolved format is singles, so the doubles selector is excluded by the bound source guard; returned item depends on selected moves, ability, role, species and team details.
paths.output_request_family: No generator-time protocol record; later public item reveal/activate/end/HP families originate in item callbacks, while held-item truth stays private until revealed.

paths.candidate_membership: format.team=random dispatches through RandomTeams.randomTeam using the bound generated move/ability/item selectors.
paths.selection: randomTeam repeatedly selects/prunes randomSet results to the format's six-member singles team limit.
paths.realizability: Direct for every target-format battle after format resolution.
paths.output_request_family: Battle/Side setup later emits public player/teamsize/poke/switch evidence and an addressed private initial request; generator internals themselves are never published.
paths.disposition: Already represented for accepted setup/request boundaries; complete episode origin retention is CE-06.

paths.candidate_membership: destinybond and glaiverush are authored Gen 9 random-set movepool candidates.
paths.selection: Both pass through randomMoveset; deterministic local generated seeds 147/Froslass and 79/Baxcalibur are asserted in tests/singlemove.test.ts.
paths.realizability: The source-generated witnesses execute their pinned callbacks for both actors; they are witness evidence, not random-episode absence proof for other paths.
paths.output_request_family: Exact public -singlemove raw records: Destiny Bond untagged and Glaive Rush with final [silent].
paths.disposition: Already represented raw-only under CE-01; lifecycle semantics remain excluded.

forms.evidence: Body Press is present in an authored Gen 9 singles random-set movepool and flows through the selected-set move generator.
Magic Bounce is an authored Gen 9 singles candidate ability selected by the generator when its set survives pruning.
The selected candidate ability can reflect a reflectable incoming move by invoking the active move against its source; this is an indirect callback path from a direct set candidate.

The Ditto Imposter candidate can invoke Transform; the simulator copies selected target state including boosts and specific volatile state. This documents the indirect source path, not acceptance of broader copied-state projection.
The package contains Dynamax simulator code, but it is not a Gen 9 singles random-set candidate or action; package-wide presence alone does not establish target-format reachability.
Preserve the reviewed -singleturn disposition as raw protocol evidence; do not promote it to typed state.

CE-01 implementation, semantic review pending: exact four base-emitter forms retained as raw evidence only. Destiny Bond/Glaive Rush have generated-set witnesses; Grudge/Rage remain package-only with indirect format reachability unproven. No typed lifecycle or broader-format support claim.

Only the four exact source-backed suffixes are raw evidence. Reordered, duplicated, invented, category-prefixed, missing-tag, extra-tag, or non-active-target forms reject before projection and publication.
